messages:
Amrita Rao: Heads-up — ClearWave's ACH bounced (R01). Invoice `C-4091` is at 37 days. Bank returned code R01, amount $12,430. They emailed asking for a short payment plan; also asked if we can waive the $50 late fee this one time.
Luca Martel: copying their last payment history — they've been a mid-size customer, steady usage but a slow month. Did collections get any prior promise?
Janelle Kim: I have their account. We sent 2 dunning emails, + one call — no commitment yet. They pinged their CFO and offered to do ACH within 7 days if fee waived.
Amrita Rao: Ok. Options: 1) waive $50 if they pay full invoice within 7 days; 2) allow 2-installment split (50/50) with CC auth now + ACH next week, but keep late fee. Which is lower risk?
Mateo Alvarez: Riskwise, CC auth now is best — we can immediately capture at least half. If they prefer ACH, R01 suggests account closed/insufficient funds. I'd recommend CC or a signed ACH retry with proof.
Priya Singh: From legal — no problem waiving a one-time fee if we document exception. Need a short email template and a note on the invoice record. Also require acceptance in writing.
Luca Martel: Proposal: Offer 7-day full pay + $50 waiver (no refunds if later chargeback). If they ask split, require signed agreement + CC token for first installment. I'll draft agreement. :pencil2:
Amrita Rao: Sounds good. Janelle, can you send the waiver offer and set a 7-day SLA in Intercom? Mark as conditional on funds clear.
Janelle Kim: On it. Drafting now. I'll include: invoice id, waiver terms, payment link (CC) and fallback (signed split plan).
CollectionsBot: NOTE: On hold until 2025-09-07 15:00 UTC per customer reply window.
Amrita Rao: After Janelle sends, loop in Priya for doc sign. If they ignore, escalate to senior collections on day 10.
Luca Martel: Agreed. Tagging @Priya Singh for legal ack after draft. :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: Ack — will review once Janelle posts draft.
Janelle Kim: Sent the message to ClearWave (thread link: https://mail.example/clearpay) — included payment link and waiver terms. Awaiting reply.
Amrita Rao: Thanks. I'll update the ledger once payment comes in or we get signed plan.
Luca Martel: Adding a quick note to the account: `one-time-late-fee-waiver-conditional`
Amrita Rao: Closing loop for now. If no reply by 1754330589 (7 days), escalate per process.
